mapper.select: SELECT c.*, fd.name AS from_dept_name, td.name AS to_dept_name, fp.name AS from_position_name, tp.name AS to_position_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM hr_employee_change c LEFT JOIN sys_dept fd ON fd.id = c.from_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept td ON td.id = c.to_dept_id LEFT JOIN hr_position fp ON fp.id = c.from_position_id LEFT JOIN hr_position tp ON tp.id = c.to_position_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.create_by WHERE c.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY c.change_date DESC, c.id DESC
